title: Bounded-below compatibility of the normalized open compositor
statement: For a quasi-compact open immersion j:U→Y and a separated locally finite-type quasi-compact morphism f:Y→S between Noetherian schemes, finite commutative coefficients R and a bounded-below complex K on U, the chosen-compactification open normalization of extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero, def-amb-etale-compact-support] followed by the ordinary bounded-below compositor restricts to the specified unbounded open-normalized compositor, through the canonical Plus compatibilities [lem-amb-etale-compact-comparisons, def-sf-etale-support-compositor]. This is the bounded-below clause of the open-locality argument; no right adjoint, counit or two-level coefficient assertion is included.

source.place: Proof paragraph 2, first sentence: etale locality of the ambient adjoint, with the open composition and evaluation counit fixed; extraction of the expanded retained stage-1 proof, steps 20,21

proof.text: Compare the chosen compactification with (j,identity) by unboundedEtaleCompactSupport_comparison_plus. comparison_coherence identifies the comparison in the reverse direction with its inverse.

Compare the identity direct-image normalizations by rightDerived_ext after precomposition with their derived units: lowerStarIdDerivedPlus_hom_app_fac and rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory_hom_fac with mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_fach give the same localization of lowerStarId. The unit equation of rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility identifies the units. Paste the resulting identity square with compactification restriction and cancel the normalization to invert the square. Paste after structural pushforward with unboundedEtaleCompactSupport_composition_plus, using naturality and associativity.
